title: Japanese Beef Skillet
description: A quick and savory Japanese-inspired beef skillet dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced bell peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Return beef to skillet and pour in warm soy sauce, Dutch mustard, sugar, and rice vinegar.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in green onions and serve hot.
Serve over rice or noodles for a complete meal.
